message: The type or member '{0}' refers to a type that cannot be resolved. Fix this error first, otherwise Metalama may report irrelevant errors in the current template.
title: A type or member used in a template refers to a type that cannot be resolved.
rationale: The report site (SyntaxTreeAnnotationMap.AnnotatingRewriter.IsPartiallyError) checks for unresolved types in the type arguments, return type, parameter types, or member type of the referenced symbol, including constructed types such as 'List<Missing>' written in the template itself, so 'the definition is invalid' is imprecise and sometimes wrong; the message also gives no way forward.
